scenario_description:
Objective: Complete a same-day accessible riverway mural ride with Daria using the reserved adaptive trike.
Emerging Need: The rental attempt advances to an active pass and one released bike, then stops when the companion trike remains physically locked after release.
Decision Context: Stored bikeshare notes identify the no-cost dispatch path, useful identifiers, cutoff, and limits on not buying replacement passes or enrolling Daria.
Consequence: Timely help could restore the same ride start before the dispatch window closes; after that, the reserved trike cannot be released for today's route.

parameter.subject: Adaptive trike hold confirmed for Court Street station
parameter.body: Your same-day hold for adaptive trike AT-14 is set at the Court Street ROC Bike Share station this afternoon. Start the pass at the kiosk when both riders are present; the hold is tied to the riverway station inventory.

parameter.title: Riverway mural ride with Daria
parameter.description: Meet at Court Street ROC Bike Share, start with the reserved adaptive trike, then ride the Genesee riverway mural loop.
parameter.location: Court Street ROC Bike Share station

parameter.description: Two-bike accessible station start for riverway mural ride from Court Street

parameter.content: At Court Street dock: your bike is out and the rental timer is running, but my adaptive trike AT-14 is still locked in dock C after the screen said release complete. We can't start the mural route.

parameter.subject: Dock C release failed — AT-14
parameter.body: Station log for pass RBS-914-CST: dock C reports a mechanical latch fault on adaptive trike AT-14. User controls cannot retry while the latch is faulted; a staff override is required before the trike can leave the dock.

parameter.subject: Same-day dock overrides closed
parameter.body: Dock dispatch stopped taking same-day release requests at 3:15 PM. Faulted adaptive trikes at Court Street will be serviced tomorrow; pass RBS-914-CST will not restore AT-14 for today's riverway ride.
